title: Rainy Night Requiem
subtitle: A forgotten case and a rain-soaked soul
premise: In the aftermath of his daughter's tragic death, former cop turned PI Jack Slade takes on a case that threatens to reopen old wounds. As he delves deeper into the truth behind a missing persons case from his troubled past, he's forced to confront the darkness that haunts him still.
main_characters: Jack Slade: Ex-cop turned PI with a taste for whiskey and a penchant for getting in over his head
Sarah Jenkins: Missing persons victim whose trail leads Jack down a rabbit hole of memories and nightmares

chapters.title: Rainy Night Routine
chapters.summary: Jack Slade sips on cheap whiskey, reliving the rain-soaked nights he spent searching for his own daughter. The phone rings, breaking the spell - a mysterious client seeks Jack's help finding Sarah Jenkins, missing for three weeks.

chapters.title: Case File: Sarah Jenkins
chapters.summary: Jack pours over the case files, piecing together what little he knows. The missing persons department's lack of progress and the cops' avoidance of him makes Jack wary - something doesn't add up.

chapters.title: Night Watch
chapters.summary: Jack spends a sleepless night at the Jenkins' apartment, hoping to catch a glimpse of what really went down. But nothing stirs, and he's left with only more questions.

chapters.title: Beneath the Surface
chapters.summary: As Jack digs deeper into Sarah's life, the walls begin to crumble: her struggles with addiction, a fraught relationship with a new lover. The truth is darker than he imagined.

chapters.title: Face-Off
chapters.summary: A tense confrontation between Jack and the victim's desperate boyfriend yields more dirt than answers. With each new revelation, Jack's grip on reality falters - his own daughter's ghost haunts him anew.

chapters.title: Dead Ends and False Leads
chapters.summary: With the PI's time running out, Jack follows a promising new lead: an eyewitness claiming to have seen Sarah last night. As he chases down the tip, the streets grow slick with rain - a deadly storm brews.

chapters.title: The Dark Side
chapters.summary: As Jack and his client find themselves trapped in an abandoned warehouse, they face the very darkness they've sought to outrun - a figure emerges from the shadows: a man with ties to Jack's past.

chapters.title: Rainy Night Closure
chapters.summary: The case is finally solved - or so it seems. As the pieces fall into place, Jack stands at a crossroads: confront the darkness head-on and salvage what's left of his soul or lose himself forever in its depths.
